items.label: Location
items.reveals: The approximate city and region your internet connection appears to be in, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

items.label: Device Type
items.reveals: Whether you are on a desktop, mobile or tablet, and which operating system, as your browser announces it.

items.label: Browser
items.reveals: Which browser and which major version you are using.

items.label: Internet Provider
items.reveals: The name of the company that provides your internet connection, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

items.label: Time Pattern
items.reveals: The local day and time on your device at the moment the scan ran.

items.label: Screen Resolution
items.reveals: The width and height of your screen in pixels.

items.label: Privacy Settings
items.reveals: Whether your browser is set to send the Do Not Track request.

items.label: Connection Type
items.reveals: The kind of connection your browser says it is on (fast mobile, Wi-Fi and so on).

items.label: How You Found Us
items.reveals: Which kind of site sent you here (search engine, social network, a link, or directly).

items.label: Device Status
items.reveals: Your battery percentage and whether it is charging, where the browser allows it.

items.label: Primary Language
items.reveals: The main language your browser is set to.

items.label: Language Fallbacks
items.reveals: The extra languages your browser lists after the main one.

items.label: Locale Mismatch
items.reveals: Whether your language setting looks out of step with the timezone you are in.

items.label: Estimated Profile
items.reveals: A rough age-band guess that the site makes from your operating system, browser and the time of day.

items.label: User Profile
items.reveals: A one-word lifestyle label (local, traveler, expatriate, multilingual) worked out from your language settings.

items.label: Orientation
items.reveals: Whether your screen is held upright or sideways.

items.label: Rotation
items.reveals: The angle your screen is rotated to, in degrees.

items.label: Tilt Forward/Back
items.reveals: How far your device is tilted forward or back, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

items.label: Tilt Left/Right
items.reveals: How far your device is tilted left or right, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

items.label: Motion Sensors
items.reveals: Whether your device has a motion sensor (gyroscope) a site could read.

items.label: Canvas Fingerprint
items.reveals: A short code produced by asking your browser to draw a hidden image; different devices draw it slightly differently.

items.label: WebGL Signature
items.reveals: The graphics card and driver name your browser reports.

items.label: Audio Signature
items.reveals: A short code produced by processing a silent sound in your browser; devices differ slightly.

items.label: Installed Fonts
items.reveals: How many fonts from a test list are installed on your device.

items.label: Extensions
items.reveals: Whether an ad blocker or browser plug-ins could be detected.

items.label: Fingerprint Protection
items.reveals: Whether your browser has a known fingerprint shield (Tor, Brave Shields, Firefox protection or a blocking extension).

items.label: WebRTC Leak
items.reveals: Whether your browser reveals your real internet address to a website even when you use a VPN.

items.label: CPU Cores
items.reveals: How many processor cores, and how much memory where reported, your device says it has.

items.label: Display Profile
items.reveals: Your screen size, colour depth and pixel density together.

items.label: Timezone/Locale
items.reveals: Your timezone and the regional format your browser uses for dates and numbers.

items.label: Battery Status
items.reveals: The battery level and charging state, or a note that the browser hides it.

items.label: Connected Devices
items.reveals: How many cameras, microphones and speakers your browser can see, without turning them on.

items.label: Cookies
items.reveals: How many cookies myprivacytool.io has stored in your browser, and how many look like trackers.

items.label: Local Storage
items.reveals: How many items this site has saved in your browser's local storage, and how big.

items.label: Session Storage
items.reveals: How many items this site holds in session storage for this tab, and how big.

items.label: IndexedDB
items.reveals: How many databases this site has created in your browser.

items.label: Cache & SW
items.reveals: Whether this site has a background service worker or saved offline files in your browser.

items.label: Google Account
items.reveals: Whether Google sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

items.label: Meta Services
items.reveals: Whether Facebook or Instagram sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

items.label: Microsoft Account
items.reveals: Whether Microsoft sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

items.label: Social Platforms
items.reveals: Whether sign-in cookies for LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit and other social platforms are visible to this page.

items.label: Cross-Site Identity
items.reveals: Whether tracking cookies from ad networks and single sign-on are visible to this page.

items.label: DNS Leak
items.reveals: A test labelled 'DNS leak' that is really a second WebRTC probe for your network addresses.

items.label: Connection Security
items.reveals: Whether you reached this site over an encrypted connection.

items.label: Mixed Content
items.reveals: Whether this page loaded any resources over an unencrypted connection.

items.label: Security Headers
items.reveals: A score for how many protective web headers this site appears to send.

items.label: Browser Status
items.reveals: Whether your browser version is older than a cut-off the code keeps in a list.

items.label: Encryption
items.reveals: Which version of encryption your connection is likely using.

items.label: Mouse Tracking
items.reveals: How many mouse movements the site recorded while you used this page.

items.label: Keystroke Dynamics
items.reveals: How many keystrokes were timed (not what you typed) while you were on this page.

items.label: Click Patterns
items.reveals: How many clicks the site recorded and how fast you click.

items.label: Scroll Behavior
items.reveals: How far down the page you scrolled and how you scrolled.

items.label: Session Duration
items.reveals: How long you have been on this page, how long active, idle, and how many times you switched tabs.

items.label: Engagement Map
items.reveals: A map of where on the page you moved and clicked the most (hotspots).

items.label: Postal area
items.reveals: Postcode and map point of the IP address, sharper than city

items.label: IP timezone vs device clock
items.reveals: Timezone of the IP against the device timezone; a gap suggests VPN, travel or proxy

items.label: Network distance
items.reveals: Round-trip time to our edge and which data centre answered; long times hint at a tunnel

items.label: Network owner type
items.reveals: Owner of the IP block: home broadband, mobile, company, cloud host

items.label: TLS handshake fingerprint
items.reveals: Hash of the ciphers and extensions the browser offers; identifies browser build and bots

items.label: HTTP version
items.reveals: HTTP/1.1, 2 or 3; older stacks and some privacy tools differ

items.label: EU visitor flag
items.reveals: Whether the IP is in the EU, which changes their legal rights

items.label: Global Privacy Control
items.reveals: Whether the browser sends the legal opt-out signal
items.plan_reason: Marked Verify: not built until a probe on our own test account confirms the field
